explanation: Composed in an early form of Sanskrit, they were passed down by memory for many centuries, recited syllable by syllable, before anyone wrote them down.

claims.text: The Vedas are sacred texts of Hinduism and are among the oldest religious texts still in use.
The Vedas are not the scriptures of Buddhism, Jainism or Sikhism.
The Vedas were composed in Vedic Sanskrit, an early form of Sanskrit.
The Vedas were passed down orally, with exact recitation, for many centuries before being written down.
